text: ADP reported seasonally adjusted private payroll growth of 98,000 in June, below the prior month and below consensus expectations. Education and health services accounted for 48,000 jobs, while nearly all employment gains occurred in services. Annual pay growth remained at 4.4% for job stayers and 6.6% for job changers.

meta.note: This entry is limited to the ADP employment release and excludes subsequent government payroll data.

text: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh described initiatives to restructure the central bank's analytical processes, communications framework, and use of real-time technologies. He stated that task-force leadership announcements are forthcoming and reiterated institutional independence. No commitment was made regarding the July FOMC interest-rate decision.

meta.note: The event concerns institutional direction rather than a monetary policy decision or economic outlook.

text: Meta announced plans to commercialize excess AI computing capacity through a cloud business serving external customers. The offering may include hosted AI models or access to computing infrastructure. Meta shares rose following the announcement, while several cloud infrastructure providers traded lower.

meta.note: The final service model remained undecided at the time of the announcement.

text: General Motors reported second-quarter U.S. sales of 714,896 vehicles, down 4.2% from a year earlier. All-electric vehicle sales declined 33%, while performance varied across pickup models. The company stated it expects to retain leadership in the full-size truck segment despite lower Silverado sales.

meta.note: Company expectations regarding market share are included as reported disclosures rather than observed market outcomes.
